Master of Data Science | Southbank Institute of Technology
Master of Data Science
Southbank Institute of Technology, Melbourne
Course overview
Duration: 2 years full-time or part-time equivalent
Intakes: February and July
Delivery: on campus, taught in English
Fees
2027 annual tuition fee for international students: A$49,800
Entry requirements
A bachelor's degree in any discipline with a weighted average mark (WAM) of at least 65%.
Prior study in programming or mathematics is recommended but not essential.
English language requirements
IELTS (Academic) overall score of 6.5 with no individual band below 6.0.
PTE Academic overall 58 with no communicative skill below 50.
Applications
Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and close when the course is full.
International students are encouraged to apply at least three months before the intake.
